extracted.intended_audience: CIA offices and ADP customer/service organizations preparing the Semiannual Report on ADP Accomplishments for submission to DDS/IPC (per OMB Circular A-79)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare the Agency submission describing new/revised ADP applications and computer operations management accomplishments for the second half of FY1971, and summarize ADP plans for FY1972, following the instructions required by OMB Circular A-79.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting period requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Inputs should describe new and revised ADP applications (Section I) and computer operations management accomplishments (Section II) during the second half fiscal year 1971 (i.e., January - June 1971).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions must cover the specified period (second half FY71) — only accomplishments and implementations occurring during that period should be reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission routing, classification, and due date
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agency's report to the International Programs Division, OMB, will be classified at the security level indicated by your submissions. Please furnish your response to DDS/IPC by 23 July.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure classification markings on submissions reflect the content; deliver responses to DDS/IPC by the stated deadline to be included in the Agency report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section I — Describe NEW OR REVISED computer-based systems implemented
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe and explain the benefits of each NEW OR REVISED computer-based system implemented during this report period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section I information normally should be furnished by ADP customer/user offices (e.g., OER, OSI, OP, OF, FMSAC). For each system, explain the benefits realized and why the system is new or revised.

rubrics_metrics.name: System Description
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly identify and explain the intelligence (or other) functions and objectives which the computerized system supports. Include identification of the Agency Program supported (i.e., category, subcategory, element, etc.), identify and explain any contractor involvement, and indicate any community interest or use of the system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concise functional objectives, program/category identifiers, note contractor roles, and state whether other internal/external communities use or are interested in the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel savings and other benefits (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish your estimate and briefly explain personnel savings and other benefits of the computerized system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide quantitative and qualitative descriptions of manpower savings and other operational benefits (efficiency, timeliness, accuracy, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimate of manual manpower if system absent
rubrics_metrics.description: (B)(1) Furnish your estimate and briefly explain the number of additional people (or man years) that would be required for the Agency to accomplish the objectives of this computer-based system if we were to perform the necessary functions manually (i.e., without a computer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide estimated additional staff or man-years required to perform the same work manually; explain assumptions and calculation basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative means and cost comparison
rubrics_metrics.description: (B)(2) If you consider an alternative means (e.g., contractor) feasible to accomplish the objectives of this system briefly explain this alternative and furnish your estimate of relative cost advantages or disadvantages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify feasible non-green/alternative approaches (contractor, manual processes, etc.) and provide comparative cost advantage/disadvantage estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other benefits (efficiency, timeliness, accuracy)
rubrics_metrics.description: (B)(3) Briefly explain other benefits of this computerized system such as increases in efficiency, timeliness, accuracy, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe non-personnel benefits, with examples or metrics where available (e.g., percent faster processing, error-rate reduction).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section II — ADP management accomplishments (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe and explain the benefits of significant ADP operations management accomplishments. Please furnish your estimate of the ADP equipment, manpower or dollar savings which should result.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section II information normally should be furnished by ADP service organizations (e.g., OCS, RID, CRS, NPIC). For each accomplishment, quantify expected equipment, manpower, or dollar savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardization or integration of computer systems
rubrics_metrics.description: (Section II item) Report accomplishments in standardization or integration of computer systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain actions taken to standardize/integrate systems and estimate resulting efficiencies, interoperability benefits, and savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improvements in ADP methods or technology
rubrics_metrics.description: (Section II item) Describe improvements in ADP methods or technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail methodological or technological changes (new processes, tools, or upgrades) and their operational benefits and cost/savings implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negotiation of ADP contracts under more favorable terms
rubrics_metrics.description: (Section II item) Describe negotiation of ADP contracts under more favorable terms than provided in the Federal Supply Schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide details of contract negotiations, terms improved versus Federal Supply Schedule, and expected dollar or resource savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress in handling ADP security problems
rubrics_metrics.description: (Section II item) Report progress in handling ADP security problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe security initiatives, mitigations, or improvements and their impact on risk posture, operations, or cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress on research and development of advanced ADP systems
rubrics_metrics.description: (Section II item) Describe progress on research and development of advanced ADP systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize R&D activities, milestones achieved, and anticipated benefits or future capabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section III — Plans for Fiscal Year 1972 (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize actions planned or underway which are expected to result in ADP accomplishments of the sort indicated in SECTIONS I and II, above. Include a statement of anticipated benefits for each such action planned or underway.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each planned action, state the expected benefits (personnel, equipment, dollar savings, efficiency gains) and link plans to the types of accomplishments reported in Sections I and II.

rubrics_metrics.name: User/Customer Plans (Section III.A)
rubrics_metrics.description: A. User/Customer Plans which deal with the application of computers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe planned or in-progress application-level initiatives from user/customer offices and the anticipated operational/benefit outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Computer Center Management Plans (Section III.B)
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Computer Center Management Plans for improving computer system operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize management-level plans at computer centers aimed at improving operations (e.g., capacity, reliability, costs) and estimate their benefits.
